title: Sauti approval record
description: Noor's decision on one exact action envelope. Hash equality proves byte identity, not that a person saw it: a fresh, unrevoked, trusted-device owner session is required. Revision 1.1.0: additive over the frozen 1.0.0. Adds unlock 'sms_code' (Carter, 2026-10-04): a session minted only after a reply from the owner's ENROLLED basic phone carried the per-proposal one-time code the hub itself sent in its read-back SMS; the code is random, stored hashed, bound to the proposal digest, single-use, expiring, with lockout. Such a record names the challenge it consumed.

schema_version.description: Revision of this schema the writer used. The digest domain stays sauti.approval_record.v1.

digest.description: Digest of the envelope exactly as rendered to the owner. Must equal the stored envelope digest at decision time and again at send time.

fact_revision.description: Current farm sheet version at decision time. Must equal the envelope's fact_revision.

owner_id.description: The tenant's registered owner. Distinct from tenant_id (the business).

device_id.description: Must be in the tenant's trusted device list. A helper, or the daughter's unlocked phone without owner unlock, is not owner context. For sms_code it is the opaque id the hub assigned to the owner's enrolled phone; a phone number never appears in a record.

unlock.description: How the owner session was authenticated. Voice or text confirmation alone never authenticates; see confirmation. sms_code (1.1.0): enrolled number AND a valid per-proposal one-time code; the session is bound to that one action.

confirmation.description: How the owner confirmed THIS action inside an authenticated session. Informational; the session is what carries authority.

session_id.description: Local owner session. Checked for freshness (max age) and against the revoked-session list at decision time.

authenticated_at.description: When the owner session was authenticated. decided_at - authenticated_at must be within the tenant's max session age.

challenge_id.description: 1.1.0, sms_code only: the one-time-code challenge this approval consumed. Required with sms_code, absent otherwise.
